dma_validation_requirements.requirement: Observe DMA submission, direction, payload length, and completion for the core data transfer.
Consume receive data and reuse buffers only after the required completion event.
Return the specified error and release transfer state after failure or timeout.
Support a subsequent operation after successful completion or completed error cleanup.

device_scenarios: Separate the sensor conversion delay from transfer completion.
Check both channel CRCs before returning converted values.
